name: quotebank
title: quotebank
description: Quotations, poems, prose passages, proverbs and lyrics by public figures: the public part of a private quote bank. Generated by tools/mirror.py from the private bank; do not edit.

resources.name: quotes
resources.description: One row per entry, sorted by id. Missing ids are entries that stay private.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Permanent identifier, Q0001 upward. Never renumbered or reused.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: The text. Verse lines are separated by ' / '.

fields.name: language
fields.description: ISO 639 code of the text.

fields.name: transliteration
fields.description: Romanisation of text not in Latin script.

fields.name: entry_type
fields.description: Kind of text.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Person who said or wrote it; for film and television, the character. Empty for anonymous texts and proverbs. Joins authors.name.

fields.name: source_work
fields.description: Most specific source known: work, chapter, letter, episode.

fields.name: category
fields.description: One theme per entry.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Keywords, separated by ';'.

fields.name: attribution
fields.description: How far the sourcing was checked: verified, paraphrase, reattributed, unverified, original, as-given, unaudited.

fields.name: translation_group
fields.description: Shared by a translation and its original, tg-001 upward.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Findings of the sourcing check, and other remarks.

resources.name: authors
resources.description: One row per author name used in quotes.csv, sorted by name (case-insensitive).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Author name exactly as written in quotes.author.

fields.name: status
fields.description: bio (person or group with a biography), alias (another spelling of a bio row), traditional (anonymous or handed-down source).

fields.name: alias_of
fields.description: For alias rows: the name of the bio row.

fields.name: born
fields.description: Year, 'c. 563 BC', 'unknown' or 'n/a (fictional)'.

fields.name: died
fields.description: Year of death, in the same form as born. Empty for the living.

fields.name: birthplace
fields.description: Place name as it is called today.

fields.name: deathplace
fields.description: Place name as it is called today.

fields.name: bio
fields.description: One paragraph, 60 to 900 characters, not starting with the name.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Remarks, e.g. disputed dates.

fields.name: checked
fields.description: What the bio was verified against. Required for bio rows.

resources.name: quotes-json
resources.description: quotes.csv as JSON: {"count": N, "entries": [...]}, one object per row with the same fields; tags is a list.
